:::{#def-held-out-set}
#### Held-out set (hold-out set)

A **held-out set** for a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$
is a list of $\nheld$ further observations,
none of them in $\trainset$,
that the [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) does not use
and on which the [prediction rule](#def-fitted-model) $\fitted$ is scored:

$$
\paren{(\heldpredval{1}, \heldoutval{1}), \ldots, (\heldpredval{\nheld}, \heldoutval{\nheld})}.
$$ {#eq-held-out-set}

:::

:::{#rem-source-held-out-set}
#### Source: Held-out set (hold-out set)

Also called a **hold-out set** [@james2021islr2e, sec. 5.1.1].

:::
